exposure: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease (MCTD) with anti-U1RNP antibodies
Positive isolated anti-U1RNP and negative anti-Ro/SSA antibodies
cohort: The study included 203 pregnancies in 94 consecutive women diagnosed with MCTD and confirmed U1RNP positivity.
finding: Women with MCTD and anti-U1RNP antibodies had a live birth rate of 72%, with those also having aPL and pulmonary or muscular involvement experiencing worse foetal outcomes.
